What this means

Disclaimer

Guidance only. This is a confidence estimate, not legal or forensic proof.

Urdu voice lab

Sample analysis of Urdu speech. Detection uses acoustics only, so it never needs to understand the words.

Why it works in Urdu

No speech-to-text. Features such as log-mel and LFCC capture how a voice is produced, not what is said.

How it works

Audio is analysed in short windows, turned into acoustic features, scored and shown as a confidence band. No speech-to-text, so it works for Urdu too.

Limits

This prototype uses a lightweight acoustic scorer in place of the trained model. Uncertain is a normal result. AudioGuard never says safe.

Privacy

No server, no account, no upload. Audio is processed in memory and discarded.

Microphone access

AudioGuard listens to check whether a voice is AI-generated. Audio is not saved or sent anywhere.
